china-1914:p0109_1.rationale: Conversion table of Chinese weight units (li, fen, ch'ien, liang, chin, tan); a measurement-system equivalence table.

china-1914:p0109_2.rationale: Fixed metric and avoirdupois equivalents of Chinese weights for foreign trade; unit conversion content.

china-1914:p0109_3.rationale: Chinese linear measures and their successive equivalents.

china-1914:p0109_4.rationale: Fixed ch'ih length for foreign Customs trade in inches and metres; a unit standard.

china-1914:p0109_5.rationale: Varying ch'ih lengths in inches across trades; measurement standards comparison.

china-1914:p0109_6.rationale: Chinese area and capacity unit equivalents; measurement-system conversion.

china-1914:p0121_1.rationale: List of paper mills by name and location, with no quantities; textual directory.

china-1914:p0121_2.rationale: Directory of printing and lithographic works and presses (including newspaper presses) by name and location, with no quantities. No vocabulary tag fits printing as an industry.
review_questions: Propose a 'printing and publishing' tag for printing works?

china-1914:p0122_1.rationale: List of railway locomotive, car and repair shops with locations; textual directory. Machinery is the closest fit for locomotive and car works.
review_questions: Propose a tag for railway workshops or rolling-stock manufacture?

china-1914:p0122_2.rationale: Directory of mills and factories by location, with no quantities. It covers rice hulling mills, saw mills and silk filatures, plus a rope factory.
review_questions: Title names only rice mills, but the body also lists rope factories, saw mills and silk filatures.
